title: The AI Loop Everyone Is Going Crazy Over #claudecode #aitools #loop
description:
AI loops are blowing up right now, and most people still don't get why they matter. A loop just means you give an AI agent an outcome and it repeats the task over and over until the result matches what you want. Think of it like a cron job, except it's intelligent. Want a website? Give it five examples of good ones and let it build, review, and rebuild until it's done, no more wasted weekends. This is how you actually let AI agents work for you.

In this short: what an AI loop is, why everyone's talking about it, and how to use AI automation to get an outcome on repeat without doing the manual work yourself.

#Shorts #AIautomation #aiagents
